analysis:
Both units are base-side text of CHANGELOG.md, documentation only. The PR adds a v0.10.8 candidate section at head lines 11-333 and leaves the base lines (v0.10.6 and earlier) unchanged. The changed head text is only visible as a truncated patch excerpt. I found no executable code, permissions or configuration changes in what was supplied, so I have no concrete security regression to cite.

The base text mentions security-relevant behaviors that the head section may extend or restate. They map to existing threats: encrypted SSD prefix-cache records and prefix reuse (T-041), the add-on sandbox installer (T-061, TB-013), App Attest and pair approvals (TB-011), and the update, rollback and quarantine path (T-043, TB-003).

Base lines 273-277 describe `darkbloom update --rollback` with hash and signature checks on the kept release and quarantine of the rolled-back one. Those lines are not part of this diff.

The remaining gap is that the full head diff (lines 11-333) was not visible, only a truncated excerpt. Any new security claims there, such as pair-update behavior, coordinator approval limits, or prefix-cache or SSD changes, would need checking against the actual source changes and the threat model. The threat model may need an update if the release notes describe new update-trust behavior, such as a pair-coordinated update installing on both Macs or on neither. That behavior would touch the T-043 watchdog and rollback authority and the TB-011 approval limits, but no code evidence was supplied here.
